board.name: Wisconsin Physician Assistant Affiliated Credentialing Board (attached to the Medical Examining Board; administered by DSPS)

totalAccepted.reason: Category 1 as defined by NCCPA, as the app names the NCCPA Category 1 sponsors.

exemption.field: First Wisconsin PA renewal after the license was issued
exemption.question: Is this the first renewal since your Wisconsin PA license was issued?
exemption.text: The CE hours, including the controlled substance hours, do not apply to the first renewal after the license is issued.

topics.label: Responsible controlled substances prescribing, 2 of the 30 hours

agreement.text: A PA keeps, and gives the board on request, either evidence of a physician led employment arrangement or a written collaborative agreement with a physician; either party may end the agreement with at least 30 days' written notice.

cycleYears.reason: PA licenses renew March 1 of each even-numbered year: every two years.

board.name: Wisconsin Board of Nursing (administered by DSPS)

cycleYears.reason: RN licenses renew March 1 of each even-numbered year.
RN licenses renew March 1 of each even-numbered year: every two years.
APRN licenses renew March 1 of each even-numbered year.

notes.text: Evidence of malpractice liability insurance is submitted at every renewal.
Renewing the APRN license also renews a Wisconsin RN license you hold.

topics.label: Clinical pharmacology or therapeutics relevant to your area of practice, all 16 hours
Responsible prescribing of controlled substances, part of the 16 hours

cycleYears.reason: APRN licenses renew March 1 of each even-numbered year: every two years.

agreement.text: An APRN practices in collaboration with a physician or dentist, documented by the APRN and not filed with DSPS, until the board verifies independent practice: 3,840 clinical hours of APRN practice with a physician or dentist available and 3,840 hours of clinical nursing, with 24 months each.
